snippet.title: Stigmata - Indie Survival Horror Game Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Stigmata is a classic survival horror experience where you must fight, explore, and manage your resources to survive. A man finds himself alone in a city where reality is beginning to unfold. Does judgement await you or something else? Your decisions directly affect the world and your experience.

Wishlist on steam here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4736910/Stigmata/
